units.name: Aegis Defence Line
game_time: If you are the defender in a scenario, you may deploy up to 3 Aegis Defence Line pieces in your deployment zone as part of prepared positions after determining who will be the attacker and who will be the defender. Aegis Defence Lines provide cover per the standard cover rules and provide no additional benefits.
